reported_status: Whole ROOT conditional charge/pressure, mediator thermal-throughput, area/duty and installed-renewal-cost contracts identify missing operations in water-to-delivered dry pressurized hydrogen. Dotan2019 initial component precedent supplies separated electrochemical H2 and hot chemical O2 operations at its actual read scope, not a complete heat-return/pressurized gas/life/cost result. No new hydrogen module, qualified joint material, lifetime or commercial quote is constructed. New whole ROOT contracts credit the existing ambient two-cell electrical mediator-regeneration precedent and derive closed-cycle signed work, useful-rate voltage budget, equal-cassette inventory/renewal and per-swap gas-quality requirements. A generic separate regenerator is prior art; actual low-loss regeneration and gas-safe economical service remain unconstructed.
